curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the wandering hunters cross paths with Ika, a woman holding the rare secret to creating flame, the perilous mission shifts from searching to learning.
curatedMovie.description: After their sacred flame is extinguished, a Cro-Magnon tribe faces ruin without the ability to reignite it. Three warriors venture across a harsh prehistoric wilderness filled with beasts and rival tribes to find fire.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful prehistoric quest told with minimal language, combining adventurous tension with moderate emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jean-Jacques Annaud builds an immersive, dialogue-free survival adventure driven by raw visual storytelling, tangible danger, and primal stakes.
